items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.excerpt: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Initia confirms second exploit in 3 weeks, $3.27M stolen in latest attack
items.excerpt: Initia said an attacker exploited compromised cloud credentials to move $3.27 million in crypto assets, with about $2.16 million remaining frozen on its halted network.

items.title: Across Protocol restores website after hackers hijack domain
items.excerpt: The cross-chain bridge said a social engineering attack targeting domain registrar Namecheap allowed hackers to redirect users to a phishing site.

items.title: Crypto ally Tom Emmer elected House GOP minority whip
items.excerpt: The Minnesota lawmaker, who helped establish the Congressional Crypto Caucus, will stay on as Republican whip after Democrats won the midterms.

items.title: LNbits rushes emergency patch after reported Bitcoin wallet thefts
items.excerpt: The project warned that installations running older versions were vulnerable and urged operators to replace potentially exposed credentials even after upgrading.

items.title: X launches its own clipping feature to spur influencer engagement
items.excerpt: X is jumping into clipping, the popular practice of cutting long videos into short, shareable clips that can go viral.

items.title: Microsoft’s DLSS competitor is out for the Xbox Ally X and works in handheld mode
items.excerpt: Microsoft is now rolling out Automatic Super Resolution (Auto SR), an upscaling technology that competes with Nvidia's DLSS, for the Xbox Ally X, Xbox Ally X20, and select Windows Copilot Plus PCs, the company announced today. Auto SR is al

items.title: CFTC warns Kalshi of imminent charges over notification of contracts: Politico
items.excerpt: The prediction markets operator says the issue involves procedural errors affecting a handful of contracts, many of which weren’t live, according to Politico.

items.title: Global banks commit $270M to stablecoin venture targeting 2027 launch
items.excerpt: Project Faro, backed by Goldman Sachs, Citigroup and BBVA, has secured $270 million in funding to launch a US dollar stablecoin in the first half of 2027.

items.title: The VR Disney Plus app on Meta Quest now has 3D movies

items.title: Oura is acquiring medical AI chatbot startup Counsel Health
items.excerpt: Oura announced its quarterly earnings today and said it agreed to acquire Counsel Health for $625 million, after adding the company's AI chatbot to its app earlier this year. Counsel Health calls itself an "AI-native primary care company,"

items.title: Can crypto trust firms compete with banks in US derivatives settlements?
items.excerpt: Crypto custodians are moving into a market handling billions in daily settlements, but regulatory relief and a shift in congressional control leave questions over their long-term role.

items.title: Across Protocol warns users to avoid app amid reports of drained wallets
items.excerpt: The protocol is investigating a potential security incident affecting its domain, while several users have reported losing funds after interacting with the platform.

items.title: OpenAI acquires Odessia, travel startup created by Sonder founder
items.excerpt: OpenAI has not yet said what its plans are for the future of travel. But Sonder founder Francis Davidson is a well-known figure in the travel industry.

items.title: Ava Labs exec says NYSE deal marks end of blockchain’s ‘general purpose era’
items.excerpt: Ava Labs’ John Nahas said the collaboration with the NYSE shows institutions moving past pilots toward purpose-built onchain market infrastructure.

items.title: Sony cancels live-service shooter Fairgames
items.excerpt: Sony has canceled Fairgames, a heist game announced in 2023, according to Bloomberg. Fairgames had once been part of Sony's big planned push for PlayStation live service games, but the company ended up canceling some planned live service ti

items.title: OpenAI, Anthropic face new oversight as New York’s AI safety law takes effect
items.excerpt: New York is preparing to enforce its sweeping AI safety law, requiring major developers like OpenAI and Anthropic to register, disclose safety practices, and report critical incidents or face fines.

items.title: Proximal Ventures raises debut fund to back startups bringing AI to drug development
items.excerpt: Former SignalFire investor Sahir Raoof raises $27.5 million for new fund targeting AI in pharma.

items.title: X-energy gets green light to build its first small modular nuclear reactors
items.excerpt: X-energy received a construction permit from the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission to build four reactors in Texas.

items.title: Kimber Digital Securities gains broker-dealer status for tokenized assets
items.excerpt: The Plume affiliate plans to offer tokenized US stocks, ETFs and bonds through self-custodial wallets, with traditional shareholder rights preserved.

items.title: All 7 Anthropic founders will each cash out about $250M in IPO
items.excerpt: Each of the seven co-founders plans to sell exactly the same number of shares in the IPO, which would bring each of them about $250 million in cash at the midpoint of the price range while leaving the group in control of the company.

items.title: The PlayStation Plus PC app is shutting down next month
items.excerpt: Sony is retiring the PlayStation Plus app for PC on December 10th. Sony says it will notify users directly about the shutdown. The app allowed PlayStation Plus Premium subscribers to stream certain games on PC, but according to Sony, not ma

items.title: Oura to acquire AI-native primary care startup Counsel Health for $625M
items.excerpt: The deal comes a few weeks after Oura postponed its up to $2.2 billion IPO indefinitely, citing “uncertainty in the IPO market.”

items.title: Starlink Mini 2 adds a swappable battery
items.excerpt: SpaceX announced a new version of its all-in-one satellite internet terminal that integrates a dish, Wi-Fi router, and now a battery into a single device about the size of a laptop. According to some users on X who shared screenshots of inv

items.title: The US is winning the AI race. Jensen Huang could have blown it
items.excerpt: As espionage targets go, Jensen Huang is perhaps one of the least surprising on Earth. The Nvidia CEO runs one of the world's most valuable companies, controls the in-demand technology fueling the AI boom, and is cozy with presidents, CEOs,

items.title: PSI is trying to make a business out of AI-driven scientific discovery
items.excerpt: PSI used an unreleased Anthropic model to answer a fundamental question about quantum computing that scientists have pursued for nearly two decades.

items.title: Google’s Pixel Tag tracker is now available
items.excerpt: After years of third-party Android trackers from companies like Samsung, Motorola, and Pebblebee, Google's Pixel Tag is now available for purchase. First announced in August, the Pixel Tag is designed to work with Google's tracking network

items.title: Google is making Pixel HiLight slightly more useful
items.excerpt: Google is adding a new feature to its underwhelming HiLight light on the back of Pixel 11 Pro phones: As part of the November 2026 Pixel Drop, the light can light up when you get Google Messages texts from your favorite contacts. Sure, it's

items.title: OpenAI rolls out new business profiles, making ChatGPT just a little bit more like Google
items.excerpt: OpenAI is looking to make ChatGPT a more robust consumer discovery engine, and a host of new features seek to empower businesses to help it do that.

items.title: Pixel Tag, Google’s $30 Android-ready answer to Apple’s AirTag, is now available
items.excerpt: Google's Pixel Tag lets you track lost items with your Android device, similar to Apple's AirTag.

items.title: One of our favorite multi-filament 3D printers is $100 off
items.excerpt: If you’re tired of filament jams and clogged nozzles, perhaps it’s time for a new 3D printer. Through December 1st, the Bambu Lab P2S Combo, currently one of the best models that’s easy to use, is discounted. It’s $649 at Best Buy, as well

items.title: Mercado Bitcoin to resume cash withdrawals after $49M hack
items.excerpt: Starting next week, customers can deposit and withdraw money through Brazil’s instant payment system. Crypto transfers remain suspended.

items.title: Hot US inflation raises odds of half-point Fed hike in December
items.excerpt: US inflation came in above forecasts in October, increasing expectations of a bigger rate hike in December and raising concerns for crypto investors.

items.title: Anthropic launches Claude Meetings to turn workplace discussions into plans and tasks
items.excerpt: As participants talk, Claude can draft the plan being discussed, map out a timeline on a whiteboard, answer questions in the meeting chat, and access connected work apps to retrieve information, such as last year's figures.

items.title: Polymarket US trading volume jumps 266% despite regulatory battles
items.excerpt: Trading volume on Polymarket’s US exchange surged from June to October, fueled by sports betting, even as the platform faces mounting regulatory scrutiny.

items.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with alleged Chinese spy: a timeline
items.excerpt: The affair could have ramifications for national security as the U.S. and China race to develop the most advanced AI infrastructure.

items.title: Sundrop turns your endless baby photos into recaps, time lapses, and more — without AI
items.excerpt: Sundrop is a new iPhone app that uses Apple's on-device AI to help parents rediscover their favorite photos and create keepsakes without uploading images to the cloud.

items.title: Bitcoin nears 11-week low after ‘discouraging’ US CPI inflation beat
items.excerpt: Bitcoin and US stocks initially fall after October inflation tops forecasts, with traders expecting a quarter-point Fed rate hike in December.

items.title: Apple TV makes sign language interpretation a built-in accessibility feature
items.excerpt: Apple TV's new accessibility feature lets viewers turn on sign language interpretation within supported titles.

items.title: Google broadens its AI hardware portfolio with two new specialized chips
items.excerpt: Google's new tensor processing units (TPUs) broaden its chip portfolio to more use cases: confidential model training and more memory capacity.

items.title: N-able takes its remote access service offline after researcher publishes dozens of zero-day bugs
items.excerpt: The remote access giant also urged its self-hosted customers to take down their own servers amid a "critical security incident," fearing the possibility of cyberattacks.

items.title: Meta’s AI agent Muse lands on Apple Watch and Android Wear OS
items.excerpt: Users can now interact with Meta’s AI assistant through voice calls, text messages, or dictation on their Apple Watch.

items.title: Reddit is turning user conversations into AI-powered product reviews
items.excerpt: Reddit's new AI-powered reviews summarize what users like and dislike about 10,000 products, helping shoppers research purchases ahead of the holidays.

items.title: New WhatsApp head wants to make the app easier to use, give its AI more chops
items.excerpt: Kunal Shah said the company wants to make voice notes, groups, stickers, and video "simpler and more expressive."

items.title: Adobe brings AI agents and new creative tools to Photoshop, Premiere, and Firefly
items.excerpt: Adobe is taking on Figma with a new prototype builder tool in Firefly.

items.title: Poland’s lower house backs sanctions bill covering crypto freezes
items.excerpt: The bill is now before the Senate and would broaden the grounds for adding people and companies to Poland’s national sanctions list.

items.title: Bitcoin’s ‘best buying opportunity ever’ has arrived: Mark Moss
items.excerpt: Bitcoin Opportunity Fund co-founder Mark Moss says that with banks and ETFs widening access to Bitcoin he expects a new record high in 2027.

items.title: Bitcoin may benefit as global tightening slows, Binance Research says
items.excerpt: Binance Research says Bitcoin could find support as global monetary tightening slows, even as markets price in a December Fed rate hike.

items.title: Coinbase, Kalshi join lawsuit backing CFTC over US stock perp futures
items.excerpt: Coinbase, Kalshi and four other companies backed the CFTC in a lawsuit over whether US exchanges can list perpetual futures tied to individual stocks.

items.title: Binance warns iOS flaw could expose crypto wallet keys
items.excerpt: The exchange urged iPhone users to remove apps installed from untrusted sources, and it is unclear whether Apple’s latest iOS updates fix the flaw.

items.title: Ex-employee sues Ethereum Foundation and Vitalik Buterin over firing
items.excerpt: Kayleen Fulton alleges she was fired less than two weeks after disclosing a cancer diagnosis and helping organize a staff letter challenging a requirement to endorse the foundation’s new mandate.

items.title: Bitcoin price eyes $74K as Fed rate-hike bets hit 96% after Waller speech
items.excerpt: Bitcoin price action and stock futures trended lower after Fed governor Christopher Waller said that he would vote to raise interest rates by 0.25% at the December FOMC meeting.

items.title: BitGo Q3 profit nearly doubles on crypto gains as revenue falls 51%
items.excerpt: BitGo’s $71 million unrealized gain on its crypto holdings helped nearly double its net income, but revenue and earnings came in below preliminary analyst expectations.

items.title: BlackRock Bitcoin ETF outflows hit $1.66B over seven trading sessions
items.excerpt: US spot Bitcoin ETFs shed $201 million Monday, with seven straight sessions of net withdrawals from BlackRock’s IBIT totaling $1.66 billion.

items.title: Securitize agrees to buy River One to expand into asset-backed lending
items.excerpt: Securitize agreed to buy River One to bring stablecoin funding to asset-backed lending and expects the deal to close in the fourth quarter of 2026.

items.title: Crypto exchanges need hard dollar caps on hot wallets, CertiK says
items.excerpt: “Cold storage is a useful measure of online exposure, but it is not a standalone security score,” the cybersecurity firm told Cointelegraph.

items.title: OpenAI builds kill switch to stop rogue agents within 35 seconds
items.excerpt: Control Room cuts off model output for internal research jobs when people or automated monitors flag safety or security concerns.

items.title: HIVE, MARA mine more Bitcoin but earn less as crypto prices fall
items.excerpt: Both miners reported higher Bitcoin production but lower mining revenue and rising electricity costs as they expanded their AI infrastructure businesses.

items.title: Should you leave Australia to avoid paying 47% tax on crypto gains?
items.excerpt: Some Australian crypto investors are moving overseas to avoid the huge CGT increase from July 2027. But there are also less drastic ways you can pay less tax.

items.title: North Korean hackers create memecoins to launder funds from Binance hack: Elliptic
items.excerpt: The blockchain firm traced stolen funds through six new tokens on NEAR, where hackers used liquidity pools to obscure transfers between wallets.
